entries.text: After the first-run quick start, Warplyn asks whether it may check for updates. Allowing or dismissing the prompt is remembered.

Linux x64 AppImage releases are now available, with installation and recovery guidance. After allowing update access, use Updates to download and explicitly restart to apply one; Warplyn saves a recovery snapshot and retains the previous image.
Turning off update network access now cancels an active download and prevents new downloads until access is allowed again.
